notes.content: Program Description The university offers the B.A. degree in English with three distinct concentrations: British and American Literature, Creative Writing, and Composition, Literacies, and Writing Studies. The student seeking a degree must observe the general university requirements stated elsewhere in this catalog as well as the specific departmental requirements stated here.

Program Description

The university offers the B.A. degree in English with three distinct concentrations: British and American Literature, Creative Writing, and Composition, Literacies, and Writing Studies. The student seeking a degree must observe the general university requirements stated elsewhere in this catalog as well as the specific departmental requirements stated here.
